  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Order fulfilment" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>place</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="system" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>label</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>track</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>monitor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="warehouse" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pick</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="logistics" name="Logistics provider">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>deliver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Order needed" />

    <bpmn:task id="track" name="Send tracking information to the customer" />
    <bpmn:task id="monitor" name="Monitor the shipment" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Order delivered" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="place" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="place" targetRef="confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="confirm" targetRef="send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="send" targetRef="pick" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="label" targetRef="handover" />

</bpmn:definitions>
